vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-93687
vulnerability.description: braces: denial of service via stack overflow from deeply nested brace patterns (no fixed release)

statements.status_notes: review-by: 2026-11-30. Found in cli-builder only, in semantic-release's dependency tree (/usr/local/lib/node_modules/semantic-release/node_modules/braces). braces 3.0.3 is the latest release and upstream has not published a fix. Accepted as a denial of service in a build-time tool, not shown unreachable: semantic-release's micromatch globs expand brace patterns from its configuration.
statements.action_statement: Move to a braces release with depth guards in its AST walkers (directly or through micromatch) and drop this statement. Re-checked on the review-by date.
